recipes.title: Basque Cheesecake
steps: Line up parchment paper on cake pan.
Add softened cheese and sugar, mix.
Slowly add eggs to cream cheese mix. Mix until smooth.
Pour into pan, tap bottom to avoid air bubbles.
Bake 45-55 min or until top is dark. Center should be 155°F.
Remove, cool at room temp (few hours). Cool in fridge for at least 1 hr before slicing.

recipes.title: PootJaiGo
recipes.description: 缽仔糕 - steamed rice cake in bowls.
steps: Mix rice flour and wheat starch with 1/2 cup water.
Use 1 1/2 cup water to dissolve the sugar (boil, then medium).
Pour the flour mix into the sugar water.
Transfer to tray and cups. Heat up the wok first, then pour in and steam on high 10 min; at 8 min add red bean.
